name: Aerosailor I: Armlet of Cloud
storyline:
Kai is an airship merchant hired to carry cargo into Firseria, the floating
royal capital. The cargo turns out to be a black-magic device built to rig
the princess's suitors' race. When it fires mid-race, Princess Aria answers
with the Armlet of Cloud — a royal artifact that commands atmospheric and
temporal energy — and the collision tears space-time. Aria spends the
Armlet's last power to seal Kai's ship inside a time-stilled cloud core and
is herself flung into the future. Kai wakes a century later in Kazamia,
where flight has been abandoned and the floating capital is gone. Following
wind-stones Aria left across the world, and aided by the Windwhisper
Brotherhood she founded, he rebuilds his ship to find the lost capital —
hunted by the disembodied soul of the man who caused it all.
summary: Aerosailor I: Armlet of Cloud is a 2.5D pixel-art role-playing game set in a cloud-bound world during an age of exploration. Players captain an airship, establish trade routes between isolated towns, explore open sky, and fight pirates in aerial cannon combat. The game features hand-drawn pixel-art environments, airship customization and trading systems, and a story centered on the Armlet of Cloud.
